name: Lumbug · Gremlet #23
description:
A firefly whose lantern glows brighter when it's excited and dims to a nightlight when it sleeps.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Lumbug in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
